title: AI Explorer Lab
objectives: Tell AI apart from traditional software
Explain Narrow AI vs General AI

stages.title: Welcome, Explorer!
stages.narration: Artificial Intelligence is already part of your everyday life. Let's go find it!

steps.text: You wake up in the morning…
Face Unlock opens your phone instantly.
YouTube already knows what you want to watch.
Google Maps suggests the fastest route to school.
Your voice assistant answers your question.

stages.title: Find AI Around You
stages.prompt: Tap every object in the room that uses Artificial Intelligence.

feedback.incorrect: This is software/electronics, but it does not use AI.

stages.title: AI vs Non-AI Challenge
stages.prompt: Sort each card into the right bucket. Does it use AI, or is it a plain program?

stages.title: Human vs AI Challenge
stages.prompt: Who is better at each task, a Human, an AI, or are they about equal?

tasks.label: Solve a giant math sum fast
tasks.explain: Computers crunch numbers far faster than people.

tasks.label: Win a game of chess
tasks.explain: AI has beaten the world's best chess champions.

tasks.label: Sense how a friend truly feels
tasks.explain: Real empathy and feelings are a human strength.

tasks.label: Learn to ride a bicycle
tasks.explain: Bodies + balance + practice, humans shine here.

tasks.label: Suggest movies you'll love
tasks.explain: Recommendation AI spots patterns in what you watch.

tasks.label: Create a brand new artwork
tasks.explain: Humans and AI can both make art, in their own way.

stages.title: Types of AI Explorer
stages.prompt: Drag each robot to its category. Hint: most AI today can only do ONE job.
stages.note: Key idea: General AI, a machine that can do ANY task a human can, does NOT exist yet.

cards.label: Robot Omega, can do ANY task

stages.title: AI in the Real World
stages.prompt: Tap each place in AI City to discover how AI helps there. Visit them all!

locations.label: Hospital
locations.info: AI helps doctors analyze medical images to spot illness earlier.

locations.label: School
locations.info: AI tutors give students hints and explanations at their own pace.

locations.label: Farm
locations.info: AI watches crop health and warns farmers about pests and water.

locations.label: Transportation
locations.info: AI optimizes routes and traffic so journeys are faster and safer.

locations.label: Home
locations.info: Smart assistants respond to your voice and control the lights.

stages.title: Final Assessment
stages.prompt: Answer at least 80% correctly to earn your badge.

questions.explain: Face Unlock learns to recognize your face, that's AI.
Learning from data (examples) is exactly what AI does.

questions.q: Which type of AI exists today?
questions.explain: Only Narrow AI (one-job AI) exists today.
AI can be wrong, especially with bad or unfair data.

questions.q: What does a recommendation system do?
questions.explain: It finds patterns in your choices to suggest more.

questions.q: Is a basic calculator an example of AI?
questions.explain: A calculator follows fixed rules, it doesn't learn.

questions.q: What helps an AI get smarter?
questions.explain: AI improves by learning from more examples.

questions.q: Which is a strength of humans over AI?
questions.explain: Empathy and real feelings are a human superpower.

questions.q: A robot that can ONLY play chess is…
Is AI a part of everyday life?
questions.explain: From maps to cameras, AI is all around us.

stages.title: Lab Complete!
messages: 🏆 You earned the AI Explorer Badge
